item.title: 20 Essential Thanksgiving Movies: Dysfunctional Families, Disastrous Dinners & The Beautiful Chaos Of Getting Together
item.description: Ah, Thanksgiving. That wonderful American tradition of gathering around a table, expressing feigned gratitude, and collectively agreeing not to examine the details of our history too closely. Nothing says national unity quite like a heavily sanitized account of colonialism served alongside mashed potatoes. But why stop at historical denialism when there are so many other uncomfortable subjects to explore? Go ahead, poke your magnificently out-of-touch uncle about his worldview, ask your parents why they never went to therapy, or casually introduce the subject of generational wealth—or, better yet, the elaborate rationalizations for stealing someone else’s land. Continue reading 20 Essential Thanksgiving Movies: Dysfunctional Families, Disastrous Dinners & The Beautiful Chaos Of Getting Together at The Playlist.
